name: Catherine Blydenburgh

relationships.evidence: Pelletreau: issue of Joseph Blydenburgh 2d and wife (Saxton) includes Joseph 3 (1732-1833) and 'Catharine, married James Smith'

bioAdditions: Daughter of Joseph Blydenburgh 2d (son of the second wife of Joseph 1st), sister of Joseph Blydenburgh (1732-1833) (S1). Not a Bull Smith descendant.

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 485-486

researchLogEntry: Round 4: parentage from Pelletreau's Blydenburgh sketch; not kin.
